name: Pulse Music v4.0.2 - Snapchat Share Fix, Instant Synced Lyrics & Endless Same-Language Queue
body:
# Pulse Music v4.0.2 - Snapchat Share Fix, Instant Synced Lyrics & Endless Same-Language Queue

Official multi-platform release and global OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, **F-Droid**, and **Obtainium**.

---

### 👻 Snapchat Creative Sharing Fix
- **Error Eliminated**: Fixed Snapchat's "Something went wrong. Please try again later" error dialog caused by unauthenticated SDK reflection and unsupported custom schemes.
- **Direct Snap Camera/Editor**: Clean Android `ACTION_SEND` intent with `EXTRA_STREAM` image content directly opens into Snapchat's Snap camera preview as a creative Snap, completely avoiding 1-on-1 private chat redirection.
- **Valid HTTPS Context**: Replaced internal schemes with canonical YouTube Music deep links so Snapchat can parse track references without throwing internal network errors.

### 🎤 Instant Line-Synced Lyrics (Lag & Glow Removed)
- **Zero-Delay Highlight**: Removed the slow, delayed artificial word-by-word space splitting and simulated neon glow from normal line-synced lyrics.
- **Perfect Vocal Sync**: The active line now highlights instantly and cleanly when the singer begins the line, matching the true vocal pacing with zero lag or stutter.

### ♾️ Truly Endless Queue with Regional Language Continuity
- **Infinite Continuation**: Removed queue deadlocks where reaching the end or skipping repeatedly played the same 10-20 songs in a loop.
- **Session History De-Duplication**: Tracks previously heard or skipped songs across the entire listening session so duplicate tracks are never recommended.
- **Smart Language Consistency**: Deep Unicode script range analysis (Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, Malayalam, Punjabi, Kannada, Korean, Japanese, English) and artist transliteration filtering ensures newly discovered songs always match the language of your currently playing tracks.
- **No Wrap-Around on Skip**: Eliminated player wrap-to-zero when skipping near the end of the queue, smoothly advancing into fresh discovered tracks.

### 💻 Windows & Multi-Platform Updates
- **Synchronized OTA Broadcast**: Version 4.0.2 (Build 102) broadcast to Orion Store, F-Droid repository, Obtainium, and in-app OTA check.
- **Signed Windows Desktop Setup**: Standalone Inno Setup executable and zip distribution package with complete YouTube login account sync.
